d: Charcoal grey, shoulder-length hair with choppy layers and uneven bangs is styled with a few silver hairpins. The eyes are a pale silvery-grey with a neutral, vacant expression, set on a face with the appearance of a late teenager. The build is slender with a medium chest. The outfit consists of a white tube top and a dark navy blue jacket draped over the shoulders, accented by a black choker and a gold necklace with a dark pendant.
